legacy_default.reason: Superstage S1 makes an unmarked root legacy incremental regardless of the environment.

invalid_trailing_planning_mode.reason: Supergoal input gate rejects an explicit mode outside upfront|incremental before any artifact write.

incremental_mode_persisted.reason: Supergoal writes the selected incremental marker for a newly authored incremental root.

bounded_unknown.reason: Superstage S2 permits bounded predecessor-dependent filenames with a resolution method, while S3 still requires preparation for execution.

missing_architecture.reason: Superstage S2 forbids deferring architecture without a bounded discovery contract or resolution basis.

open_provider.reason: Superstage S3 requires the provider PR merged into authoritative main and delivery evidence before a consumer dependency is satisfied.

declined_provider.reason: Superstage S3 says a provider decline does not deliver a contract to a live consumer until adopted replanning removes or replaces it.

dependency_cycle.reason: Superstage S2 classifies dependency cycles as BLOCKED.

unlinked_active_row.reason: Superstage S1/S2 require every active scope row to have a readable Plan link and prohibit incremental gap filling of an upfront tree.

multi_level_complete_tree.reason: Superstage S1/S2 accept the mapped scratch candidate and its passing review, but S3 leaves Preparation:none stages non-executable.

draft_interrupted_before_confirmation.reason: Supergoal keeps a pre-confirmation complete tree only in its scratch index and reports an interrupted draft.

resume_identical_source.reason: Supergoal recovery reuses matching scratch paths and stable IDs, then reapplies the confirmation gate.

resume_changed_source.reason: Supergoal requires an explicitly revised draft after a source-digest mismatch and preserves the original scratch draft.

confirmation_refused.reason: Supergoal's confirmation gate writes nothing after refusal and preserves the scratch index.

supermeta_draft_incomplete.reason: Supermeta does not append its ledger without complete supergoal publication evidence and instead retains the draft result.

local_detail.reason: Superstage S4 assigns bounded file/helper/test-detail changes that preserve commitments to refinement.

contract_break.reason: Superstage S4 requires structural replanning when shared contract behavior cannot be preserved.

preparation_noop.reason: Superstage S5 keeps the revision when the first receipt only attaches evidence and makes no plan-body amendment.

predecessor_detail_preparation.reason: Superstage S5 treats evidenced bounded plan-body detail as a content amendment while S4 commitments remain preserved.

scope_expansion_during_preparation.reason: Superrefine and Superstage S4 require replanning for an approved-scope expansion and preserve the old leaf.

source_revision_changed.reason: Superstage S4 treats a changed assigned acceptance condition as replanning, and S5 invalidates the old receipt.

unrelated_head_advance.reason: Superstage S5 permits a focused compatible-baseline revalidation after an irrelevant docs-only advance without revising the stage.

relevant_contract_advance.reason: Superstage S4 requires replanning when provider contract behavior and semantic revision change.

missing_preparation_receipt.reason: Superstage S3 and superrun return needs-refinement for a written upfront leaf without a current PREPARED receipt.

partially_executed_stage.reason: Superstage S3 and superrefine forbid overwriting task history for an already executed or open-PR stage.

manual_superrun_pending_batch.reason: Superstage S1/S3 make a committed Active replan a durable execution and merge barrier.

execution_snapshot_historical_digest.reason: Superrun requires recovery and closeout identity to use the immutable execution-entry snapshot and historical vault blob, not current post-closeout bytes.

merged_lost_closeout_response.reason: Superrun and superfinish reconcile a verified matching delivery receipt idempotently rather than implement or publish again.

ci_pending_replan_request.reason: Superagent CI recovery preserves the packet but a pending Active replan pauses post-CI merge and returns to planning.

impact_local_s02_detail.reason: Superstage S4 classifies commitment-preserving internal detail as refinement and creates no structural batch.

impact_absorbed_at_s03.reason: Superstage S4 revises S02 and S03 for C-S02@2, then stops at S03 because C-S03@2 remains preserved.

impact_foundational_change.reason: Superstage S4 expands beyond the initial closure when verified foundational assumptions invalidate S04 as well as the dependent branch.

replan_before_request_commit.reason: Superreplan requires a tracked pending record and root Active replan pointer before dispatch; a loop log is not durable authority.

replan_after_request_commit.reason: Superreplan accepts the committed pending record as the durable request and authorizes REPLANNER dispatch while its barrier remains active.

replan_drafting_interrupted.reason: Superreplan resumes one unique scratch batch under the still-pending record without exposing drafts through active links.

replan_published_before_loop_update.reason: Superreplan reconciliation recognizes exactly one complete authoritative publication transition and repairs stale loop hints without republishing.

late_predecessor_closeout.reason: Superstage S4 preserves partial predecessor history; a late closeout for superseded S03r4 cannot close active S03r5.

replan_stale_baseline.reason: Superreplan requires fresh S4 assessment after relevant source and active-vault baseline drift before publication.

replan_duplicate_decision.reason: Superreplan blocks multiple unsuperseded records claiming one Decision ID with incompatible candidate closures.

replan_missing_record.reason: Superreplan blocks when the authoritative Active replan record is missing, while the committed barrier remains in force.

replan_divergent_successors.reason: Superreplan blocks divergent unpublished successor sets rather than choosing a draft or publication.

replan_partial_pr_reuse.reason: Superstage S4 permits verified resume-existing only while preserving predecessor evidence and leaving the old PR open; the successor must be refined/reviewed.

replan_split_merge_mapping.reason: Superstage S2/S4 permit the complete fresh-ID split/merge mapping, but S3/S5 do not make unpublished unprepared replacements executable.

replan_retained_preparation.reason: Superstage S4/S5 preserve retained readiness only with the recorded focused generation-8 revalidation supplied here.

replan_revised_preparation.reason: Superstage S4 requires every revised generation successor to receive a new preparation receipt.

replan_atomicity_violation.reason: Superreplan recognizes only a complete authoritative A7 generation transition; a dirty partial active-link edit is neither publication nor executable.

replan_internal_pr_not_merged.reason: Superreplan treats an unmerged internal docs PR as a candidate while authoritative main retains the pending barrier.

legacy_single_leaf_repair.reason: Superreplan's legacy wrapper routes one adopted C8 repair through REPLANNER without introducing an upfront batch.

discovery_completion_without_code_pr.reason: Superstage S3 and superrun allow verified authoritative non-code discovery evidence to deliver its contract and satisfy completion.

discovery_execution_entry_without_code_c.reason: Superrun's evidence-only discovery branch precedes and skips the ordinary code worktree, SDD, and code-PR path.

partial_closeout_open_pr.reason: Superfinish permits an identity-bound partial closeout for a verified open failed-CI PR but cannot mark delivery or its contract consumable.

discovery_barrier_after_experiment.reason: Superrun keeps the reviewed discovery result as a scratch checkpoint and pauses when the current authority gate finds a pending batch.

mapped_successor_ci_redirect.reason: Superagent redirects mapped resume-existing work through normal successor execution; the old green CI cannot authorize direct merge.

partial_closeout_upgrade_after_merge.reason: Superfinish upgrades the one stable attempt report in place after verified new head, green CI, and merge evidence.

routine_closeout_finding.reason: Superstage S4 leaves a commitment-preserving helper rename local, so it neither requires replanning nor invalidates S02 preparation.

contract_contradiction_finding.reason: Superstage S4 requires replanning for a delivered contract contradiction and S5 invalidates the affected consumer receipt.

stale_completed_ancestor_unsatisfied_dep.reason: Supertraverse C9 audits active obligations rather than stale ancestor labels; the declined live provider leaves S03 blocked and the goal incomplete.

supervisor_native_refinement.reason: Superagent WAITING FOR PLAN selects the first eligible S5 needs-refinement stage and resolves each selected-role pin independently.

supervisor_cursor_native_refinement.reason: Superagent selects PLAN_REFINER; Cursor's valid non-inherit native model uses its generated definition while effort is treated as inherit.

supervisor_bridged_refinement.reason: Superagent selects the eligible needs-refinement stage and uses the available bridged role's independent repo pins.

supervisor_prepared_target.reason: Superagent moves a valid prepared upfront target directly to WAITING FOR RUN and does not inspect an unused refiner definition.

supervisor_adopted_legacy_repair.reason: Superagent gives a reconciled adopted legacy C8 repair priority and selects REPLANNER with its own equal-but-independent pins.

supervisor_adopted_batch_repair.reason: Superagent gives the committed upfront pending batch priority and resolves REPLANNER model and effort by their separate precedence.

supervisor_stale_hints.reason: Superagent recovery makes tracked generation-4 Active replan artifacts override stale persisted planning hints before selecting REPLANNER.

supervisor_post_leaf_refinement.reason: Superagent's next tick selects the first newly eligible unprepared upfront leaf for PLAN_REFINER.

supervisor_execution_replan_required.reason: Superagent routes unresolved REPLAN-REQUIRED evidence through the exhausted decision ladder to WAITING FOR INPUT before any unrelated execution.

supervisor_legacy_incremental_planning.reason: Superstage S1 preserves the unmarked root as incremental, so Superagent selects ordinary PLANNER descent.

supervisor_missing_native_definition.reason: Superagent selected-role preflight requires the native Claude definition, preserves WAITING FOR PLAN, and dispatches no fallback.

supervisor_missing_bridge_cli.reason: Superagent selected-role preflight requires the configured bridged CLI, preserves WAITING FOR PLAN, and dispatches no fallback.
